# OTRATTW switch part numbers and types

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Select a V2 series momentary switch and choose based on the 5th digit 'u' to determine internal lighting wiring configuration. [t751]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Select a V2 series momentary switch for the specific circuit type.
2. Choose based on the 5th digit 'u' to determine internal lighting wiring configuration.

_Procedure reported by [t751]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-swap-stock-switches-to-otrattw-switches.5311/>_

## Parts

- V2D1160B-00000-000: SPST momentary with 1 incandescent upper light, independently wired [t751]
- V2D1B60B-00000-000: SPST momentary with upper incandescent that only comes on when pressed [t751]
- V2D1S00B-00000-000: SPST momentary with no illumination [t751]
- V2D2GHNB-AAC00-000: SPST momentary with green upper LED and amber lower LED [t751]

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that for LED switches, the lower light is often only on when the switch is being pressed. [t751]
